_events_comment: Individual digests this VM recorded, so the inputs a register is built from are pinned and not only the folded result. cfv is the RTMR[0] EV_EFI_PLATFORM_FIRMWARE_BLOB2 digest. The two image digests are the RTMR[1] EV_EFI_BOOT_SERVICES_APPLICATION Authenticode digests, in order: firmware measured the PE images it loaded, while the tool recomputes them from the UKI file and its .linux section, so these are what says the two agree.
